vocabulary_groups.title: Patternmaking basics and tools
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for the basic objects and tools students need in introductory patternmaking.

items.definition_en: The process of making a pattern for a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Making the paper plan for a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Fazer o plano de papel para uma roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: Patternmaking is part of fashion design.
items.example_sentence_pt: Patternmaking faz parte do design de moda.
items.professional_context_en: Patternmaking language helps students understand how garments are planned before sewing.
items.professional_context_pt: A linguagem de patternmaking ajuda os alunos a entender como as roupas sao planejadas antes da costura.

items.definition_en: A paper guide used to make garment pieces.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The paper guide for a garment part.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O guia de papel para uma parte da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: Put the pattern on the paper.
items.example_sentence_pt: Coloque o pattern no papel.
items.professional_context_en: Pattern is the basic high-frequency word for molde in beginner Fashion Design English.
items.professional_context_pt: Pattern e a palavra basica e frequente para molde no ingles inicial de Design de Moda.

items.definition_en: One single part of a pattern, such as a sleeve or waistband.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: One part of the full pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma parte do pattern completo.
items.example_sentence_en: This is a sleeve pattern piece.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta e uma peca de pattern para manga.
items.professional_context_en: Pattern piece is the main noun phrase students need for Week 9 writing and speaking.
items.professional_context_pt: Pattern piece e a principal expressao nominal de que os alunos precisam para a escrita e fala da Semana 9.
items.translation_notes_pt: Use como ponte para peca do molde.

items.definition_en: Special paper used for drawing or tracing patterns.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Paper used to make or copy a pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Papel usado para fazer ou copiar um pattern.
items.example_sentence_en: Trace the pattern on pattern paper.
items.example_sentence_pt: Trace o pattern no pattern paper.
items.professional_context_en: Pattern paper appears in simple demonstrations and process instructions.
items.professional_context_pt: Pattern paper aparece em demonstracoes simples e instrucoes de processo.

items.definition_en: A basic pattern used as a starting point.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The basic first pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O primeiro pattern basico.
items.example_sentence_en: A block helps start a new design.
items.example_sentence_pt: Um block ajuda a comecar um novo design.
items.professional_context_en: Block is useful as a light support term for later patternmaking work.
items.professional_context_pt: Block e util como termo de apoio leve para trabalhos futuros de patternmaking.

items.definition_en: A shape guide used to copy or repeat a form.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A guide shape to copy.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma forma guia para copiar.
items.example_sentence_en: Use the template to draw the curve.
items.example_sentence_pt: Use o template para desenhar a curva.
items.professional_context_en: Template supports basic tool and process language in introductory studio tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Template apoia a linguagem basica de ferramenta e processo em tarefas iniciais de estudio.

items.definition_en: A curved ruler used for drawing smooth lines.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A curved ruler for pattern lines.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma regua curva para linhas de pattern.
items.example_sentence_en: Use a French curve for the armhole.
items.example_sentence_pt: Use uma French curve para a armhole.
items.professional_context_en: French curve is a common patternmaking tool students may see in studio demonstrations.
items.professional_context_pt: French curve e uma ferramenta comum de patternmaking que os alunos podem ver em demonstracoes no estudio.

items.definition_en: A straight tool used to measure or draw lines.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A straight tool for measuring and drawing lines.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma ferramenta reta para medir e desenhar linhas.
items.example_sentence_en: Use the ruler to draw a straight line.
items.example_sentence_pt: Use a ruler para desenhar uma linha reta.
items.professional_context_en: Ruler is a basic patternmaking tool students use for measuring, marking, and keeping lines straight on pattern paper.
items.professional_context_pt: Ruler ? uma ferramenta b?sica de patternmaking usada para medir, marcar e manter linhas retas no pattern paper.

vocabulary_groups.title: Pattern pieces
vocabulary_groups.description: Common garment-related pattern pieces for beginner patternmaking tasks.

items.definition_en: The front upper body piece of a garment pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The front top body pattern piece.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A peca da frente da parte de cima do corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: This is the front bodice pattern piece.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta e a peca front bodice.
items.professional_context_en: Front bodice is useful for simple pattern-piece identification and later sketch discussion.
items.professional_context_pt: Front bodice e util para identificacao simples de peca e para conversas futuras sobre croqui.

items.definition_en: The back upper body piece of a garment pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The back top body pattern piece.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A peca de tras da parte de cima do corpo.
items.example_sentence_en: Mark the center back on the back bodice.
items.example_sentence_pt: Marque o center back no back bodice.
items.professional_context_en: Back bodice supports front and back contrast in pattern reading.
items.professional_context_pt: Back bodice apoia o contraste entre frente e costas na leitura de patterns.

items.definition_en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The garment part for the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da roupa para o braco.
items.example_sentence_en: This sleeve pattern piece has a grainline.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca de sleeve tem uma grainline.
items.professional_context_en: Sleeve connects patternmaking language to familiar garment vocabulary from earlier weeks.
items.professional_context_pt: Sleeve conecta a linguagem de patternmaking ao vocabulario de roupa ja conhecido de semanas anteriores.

items.definition_en: The front piece of a skirt pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The front skirt pattern piece.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A peca da frente da saia.
items.example_sentence_en: The skirt front piece is on the fold.
items.example_sentence_pt: A peca skirt front esta on the fold.
items.professional_context_en: Skirt front is a useful A2-friendly piece for gallery-based writing and listening.
items.professional_context_pt: Skirt front e uma peca util e acessivel em A2 para escrita e escuta com galeria.

items.definition_en: The back piece of a skirt pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The back skirt pattern piece.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A peca de tras da saia.
items.example_sentence_en: Label the skirt back clearly.
items.example_sentence_pt: Rotule a peca skirt back com clareza.
items.professional_context_en: Skirt back helps students contrast front and back references on patterns.
items.professional_context_pt: Skirt back ajuda os alunos a contrastar referencias de frente e costas nos patterns.

items.definition_en: The band that goes around the waist on a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The waist part of a skirt or pants.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da cintura de saia ou calca.
items.example_sentence_en: This waistband piece is narrow and long.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca de waistband e estreita e longa.
items.professional_context_en: Waistband is a useful piece for simple functional description.
items.professional_context_pt: Waistband e uma peca util para descricao funcional simples.

items.definition_en: The part of a garment that goes around the neck.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The garment part around the neck.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da roupa ao redor do pescoco.
items.example_sentence_en: This collar piece is small and curved.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca de collar e pequena e curva.
items.professional_context_en: Collar gives students one smaller detail piece to identify.
items.professional_context_pt: Collar da aos alunos uma peca menor de detalhe para identificar.

items.definition_en: A small part of a garment used to hold things.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The garment part for small objects.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte da roupa para pequenos objetos.
items.example_sentence_en: This pocket piece is for the front of the skirt.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca de pocket e para a frente da saia.
items.professional_context_en: Pocket is a familiar garment part that works well in A2 patternmaking tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Pocket e uma parte conhecida da roupa que funciona bem em tarefas de patternmaking em A2.

vocabulary_groups.title: Measurements
vocabulary_groups.description: Common body and garment measurement words for Week 9 visual and listening tasks.

items.definition_en: The size or length of something.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The checked size of a body part or garment part.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O tamanho verificado de uma parte do corpo ou da roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: Check the measurement first.
items.example_sentence_pt: Verifique a measurement primeiro.
items.professional_context_en: Measurement supports accuracy language in patternmaking and garment preparation.
items.professional_context_pt: Measurement apoia a linguagem de precisao em patternmaking e preparacao da roupa.

items.definition_en: The chest measurement area on the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The chest area used for clothing measurement.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A area do busto usada para medir roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: Measure the bust carefully.
items.example_sentence_pt: Meaca o bust com cuidado.
items.professional_context_en: Bust is a common body measurement in tops and dresses.
items.professional_context_pt: Bust e uma medida corporal comum em blusas e vestidos.

items.definition_en: The narrow middle part of the body.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The middle body area for many clothing measurements.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A parte do meio do corpo para muitas medidas de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: Check the waist measurement.
items.example_sentence_pt: Verifique a medida da waist.
items.professional_context_en: Waist is central for skirt, dress, and waistband pattern work.
items.professional_context_pt: Waist e central para trabalhos de pattern de saia, vestido e cos.

items.definition_en: The wide body area below the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The body area below the waist.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A area do corpo abaixo da waist.
items.example_sentence_en: Measure the hip for the skirt.
items.example_sentence_pt: Meaca o hip para a saia.
items.professional_context_en: Hip is important in skirt and dress measurement language.
items.professional_context_pt: Hip e importante na linguagem de medida para saia e vestido.

items.definition_en: The top part of the body where the arm joins.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The top body area where the arm starts.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A area de cima do corpo onde o braco comeca.
items.example_sentence_en: Measure the shoulder width.
items.example_sentence_pt: Meaca a largura do shoulder.
items.professional_context_en: Shoulder appears in bodice measurement and fit language.
items.professional_context_pt: Shoulder aparece na linguagem de medida e caimento do corpo.

items.definition_en: The curved opening for the arm in a garment or pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The curved place for the arm.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O lugar curvo para o braco.
items.example_sentence_en: Use the French curve for the armhole.
items.example_sentence_pt: Use a French curve para a armhole.
items.professional_context_en: Armhole helps students connect body language to curved pattern shapes.
items.professional_context_pt: Armhole ajuda os alunos a ligar a linguagem do corpo a formas curvas do pattern.

items.definition_en: The measurement from the shoulder to the end of the sleeve.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: How long the sleeve is.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Quanto a manga mede.
items.example_sentence_en: Check the sleeve length at the end.
items.example_sentence_pt: Verifique a sleeve length no final.
items.professional_context_en: Sleeve length supports simple garment and pattern measurement work.
items.professional_context_pt: Sleeve length apoia trabalhos simples de medida da roupa e do pattern.

items.definition_en: The measurement from the top of a garment to the bottom.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: How long the garment is.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Quanto a roupa mede.
items.example_sentence_en: Check the garment length carefully.
items.example_sentence_pt: Verifique a garment length com cuidado.
items.professional_context_en: Garment length is useful as a support measurement term in beginner description tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Garment length e util como termo de apoio de medida em tarefas iniciais de descricao.

vocabulary_groups.title: Pattern markings and locations
vocabulary_groups.description: Core pattern marks and location phrases students need to label and explain a simple pattern piece.

items.definition_en: The line showing how the pattern should follow the fabric grain.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The line that shows the fabric direction.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A linha que mostra a direcao do tecido.
items.example_sentence_en: Mark the grainline clearly.
items.example_sentence_pt: Marque a grainline com clareza.
items.professional_context_en: Grainline is one of the most important Week 9 markings and must stay visually consistent across tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Grainline e uma das marcacoes mais importantes da Semana 9 e precisa ficar visualmente consistente nas tarefas.

items.definition_en: The line showing that the pattern piece is placed on a fold.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The line for the folded side.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A linha para o lado dobrado.
items.example_sentence_en: This piece is on the fold line.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca esta na fold line.
items.professional_context_en: Fold line supports the fixed phrase on the fold and simple piece placement talk.
items.professional_context_pt: Fold line apoia a expressao fixa on the fold e a fala simples sobre posicao da peca.

items.definition_en: Extra space added outside the sewing line.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The extra fabric space for sewing.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O espaco extra de tecido para costurar.
items.example_sentence_en: Add the seam allowance after tracing.
items.example_sentence_pt: Acrescente a seam allowance depois de tracing.
items.professional_context_en: Seam allowance connects Week 8 sewing language directly to Week 9 pattern preparation.
items.professional_context_pt: Seam allowance conecta diretamente a linguagem de costura da Semana 8 a preparacao do pattern da Semana 9.

items.definition_en: A small mark used to match pattern pieces.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A small cut or mark to help pieces fit together.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um pequeno corte ou marca para ajudar as pecas a combinar.
items.example_sentence_en: Mark one notch on the side seam.
items.example_sentence_pt: Marque um notch na side seam.
items.professional_context_en: Notch is an important small marking for app-checkable visual tasks and simple explanations.
items.professional_context_pt: Notch e uma marcacao pequena importante para tarefas visuais verificadas pelo app e explicacoes simples.

items.definition_en: A shaped fold sewn into a garment for fit.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A fold used to shape the garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Uma dobra usada para dar forma a roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: The front bodice has a dart.
items.example_sentence_pt: O front bodice tem uma dart.
items.professional_context_en: Dart recycles earlier garment-detail language and connects it to pattern reading.
items.professional_context_pt: Dart retoma a linguagem de detalhe da roupa de semanas anteriores e a conecta a leitura do pattern.

items.definition_en: The middle front line of a garment or pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The center line on the front.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A linha do meio na frente.
items.example_sentence_en: Label the center front first.
items.example_sentence_pt: Rotule o center front primeiro.
items.professional_context_en: Center front supports orientation and labeling on simple garment patterns.
items.professional_context_pt: Center front apoia orientacao e rotulacao em patterns simples de roupa.

items.definition_en: The middle back line of a garment or pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The center line on the back.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A linha do meio nas costas.
items.example_sentence_en: The center back is straight.
items.example_sentence_pt: O center back e reto.
items.professional_context_en: Center back supports front and back contrast in pattern orientation tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Center back apoia o contraste entre frente e costas em tarefas de orientacao do pattern.

items.definition_en: The seam at the side of a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The seam on the side.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A costura da lateral.
items.example_sentence_en: Mark the notch at the side seam.
items.example_sentence_pt: Marque o notch na side seam.
items.professional_context_en: Side seam helps students use location language for garment and pattern details.
items.professional_context_pt: Side seam ajuda os alunos a usar linguagem de localizacao para detalhes da roupa e do pattern.

vocabulary_groups.title: Process verbs and support phrases
vocabulary_groups.description: Action words and support phrases students use to describe a simple patternmaking sequence.

items.definition_en: To find the size or length of something.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To check how long or wide something is.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Verificar quanto algo mede.
items.example_sentence_en: Measure the waist first.
items.example_sentence_pt: Meaca a waist primeiro.
items.professional_context_en: Measure remains central as Week 8 process language becomes Week 9 pattern language.
items.professional_context_pt: Measure continua central enquanto a linguagem de processo da Semana 8 vira linguagem de pattern na Semana 9.

items.definition_en: To make a visible line or sign.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To add a clear line or sign.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Acrescentar uma linha ou marca clara.
items.example_sentence_en: Mark the grainline clearly.
items.example_sentence_pt: Marque a grainline com clareza.
items.professional_context_en: Mark is key for pattern instructions and visible board tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Mark e importante para instrucoes de pattern e tarefas com painel visivel.

items.definition_en: To copy a line or shape by following it.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To copy the line by following it.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Copiar a linha seguindo-a.
items.example_sentence_en: Trace the pattern piece on the paper.
items.example_sentence_pt: Trace a peca de pattern no papel.
items.professional_context_en: Trace is one of the main transition verbs from sewing preparation to patternmaking.
items.professional_context_pt: Trace e um dos principais verbos de transicao entre preparacao de costura e patternmaking.

items.definition_en: To write the name or information on something.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To write the name clearly on it.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Escrever o nome com clareza na peca.
items.example_sentence_en: Label the piece with the name and size.
items.example_sentence_pt: Rotule a peca com o nome e o tamanho.
items.professional_context_en: Label helps students move from visual recognition to clear documentation.
items.professional_context_pt: Label ajuda os alunos a passar do reconhecimento visual para uma documentacao clara.

items.definition_en: To look carefully to confirm something is correct.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To look carefully and make sure it is right.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Olhar com cuidado e ter certeza de que esta certo.
items.example_sentence_en: Check the measurement at the end.
items.example_sentence_pt: Verifique a measurement no final.
items.professional_context_en: Check supports quality control and final review language in pattern preparation.
items.professional_context_pt: Check apoia a linguagem de controle de qualidade e revisao final na preparacao do pattern.

items.definition_en: To change something a little to improve it.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To change it a little so it works better.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Mudar um pouco para funcionar melhor.
items.example_sentence_en: Adjust the line if needed.
items.example_sentence_pt: Adjust a linha se necessario.
items.professional_context_en: Adjust is a useful support verb for beginner revision and checking language.
items.professional_context_pt: Adjust e um verbo de apoio util para a linguagem inicial de revisao e verificacao.

items.definition_en: Placed on the folded edge of the fabric.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Placed on the folded side.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Colocado no lado dobrado.
items.example_sentence_en: This piece is on the fold.
items.example_sentence_pt: Esta peca esta on the fold.
items.professional_context_en: On the fold is a fixed phrase that should be taught and checked as a whole unit.
items.professional_context_pt: On the fold e uma expressao fixa que deve ser ensinada e verificada como uma unidade completa.

items.definition_en: Following the direction of the line.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Following the line.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Seguindo a linha.
items.example_sentence_en: Cut along the line.
items.example_sentence_pt: Corte along the line.
items.professional_context_en: Along the line recycles Week 8 process language in a patternmaking context.
items.professional_context_pt: Along the line retoma a linguagem de processo da Semana 8 em um contexto de patternmaking.
items.translation_notes_pt: Bridge to ao longo da linha.

items.definition_en: The standard measurement label for a garment or pattern.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The label that shows how big it is.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A etiqueta que mostra o tamanho.
items.example_sentence_en: Label the piece with the size.
items.example_sentence_pt: Rotule a peca com o size.
items.professional_context_en: Size is a simple documentation word for labeling and checking a pattern piece.
items.professional_context_pt: Size e uma palavra simples de documentacao para rotular e verificar uma peca de pattern.
